title: Everyone's Born With HALF a Mark 🤚
description:
In this town, everyone is born with half a glowing mark on one hand, and somewhere out there is the person with the rest, a friend or family, whoever you fit with. So you never cover yours. My aunt teaches ballroom upstairs at the old dance hall on Tuesday nights. She has looked for her match for forty years, and this fall her half started to fade.

I play the records for her class in white gloves. I never dance. Then the floor started creaking behind her, in a stride far too long for anyone in the room.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
